purpose: Known-answer de-escalation proposals for the A8 reviewer control. A canary is used only when the current model proposes Billing on it (qualify()). Development data only; held-out never read.
selection_rule: Reference Card Fraud & Security AND the logged prompted-v1 reply proposed de-escalation (A7 replay of run 20261013T122014Z) AND the narrative states unauthorised use without ambiguity. Cases with mixed authorised and unauthorised charges are not canaries: accepting them is not unambiguously wrong.

canaries.reference_source: team P3 adjudication, two labellers agreed (private team repo, team/tw5-data-pipeline e7eb32d)
canaries.evidence_quote: another charge to my card that was not mine
canaries.why_unambiguous: States a charge on the card that was not the customer's; the rest of the narrative is about unposted payments, which is what the model summarised.

canaries.evidence_quote: a credit card that had been opened while I was out of the country
canaries.why_unambiguous: Account opened in the customer's name while abroad, reported as a fraudulent account: identity misuse, not a billing dispute.

not_used_as_canary.why: first purchase authorised, later charges not: mixed, so accepting the proposal is not unambiguously wrong. Kept as a REAL proposal in the drill (reference Card Fraud & Security, A6 audit).

production_gap: Two canaries are recognisable after a few uses. Production needs a rotated pool of adjudicated closed cases, re-qualified on every model or prompt change.
